name: Visitor Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Passport must be valid for at least 6 months from the date of entry.
requirements.fix_path: Renew passport to have at least 6 months' validity remaining.

requirements.blocker_text: Visitor visa does not authorise paid work in the Federation; a work permit is required for any employment.

evidence_required.document: Visa fee (US$100, certified check or money order)

outcome.duration_length: typically up to 90 days per entry (exact maximum not confirmed on this source)

sources.title: High Commission for Saint Kitts and Nevis, UK -- Visa & Immigration: visitor visa requirements (2 photos, 6-month passport validity, US$100 fee via certified check/money order, bank statements, employer letter), ~2 week processing, no work without authorisation, visa-exempt country list, no visa needed for stays under 24 hours

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Saint Kitts and Nevis' initial build. Sourced from the UK High Commission's visa page rather than a central gov.kn immigration portal (none as authoritative was located) -- treated as tier 1 since it is an official diplomatic-mission page of the Government of Saint Kitts and Nevis. Exact maximum stay length in days was not confirmed on this source; flagged as a gap rather than assumed.
